title: The SplatStudio Product Design Hackathon is here!
body:
Win up to $1,000 in tokens: Share your website, app, or product design built with SplatStudio on X. The 10 entries with the most likes win prizes!
Rewards for the first 50 submissions: Join the SplatStudio Discord or Feishu community and share your work. The first 50 participants each get $5 in tokens!
40% better prototype designs: Upgrade to version 0.22.0 or later to experience SplatStudio’s latest design improvements!

zh-CN.title: SplatStudio 产品设计黑客松来了！
zh-CN.body:
最高获价值 1000 美金 Token：分享用 SplatStudio 做的网页/App/产品设计到 X，点赞 Top 10 均可获奖；
前50位投稿都有奖：加入SplatStudio Discord/飞书社群分享作品，前 50 名人人可得 $5 Token；
原型设计效果提升 40%：升级 0.22.0 及以上版本，体验最新SplatStudio设计效果！
